input_fields.name: save_record
input_fields.description: Caller-supplied save record with matching run_ref, status=passed, and sha256.

result_fields.name: status
result_fields.description: passed/failed based on supplied record and file identity.

result_fields.name: run_ref
result_fields.description: Run identity used to bind save_record.

result_fields.name: native_save_observed
result_fields.description: Always false; this host check does not observe the save event.

procedure: Validate .scdoc suffix, nonempty run_ref, and save_record.run_ref equality.
Require save_record.status=passed and save_record.sha256 equal expected_sha256 before reading the output.
Read the file through the VA-19 identity check and return the flat VA-20 result.
Do not reopen the model or convert file consistency into direct native-save observation.
rejection_rules: Reject wrong extension, missing/mismatched run_ref, failed/inconsistent save record, malformed hash, or missing/reparse file.
Do not claim native_reopen or direct save observation.
